children: NSE's IPO drew full subscription from qualified institutional buyers on Friday, the second day of bidding, taking overall demand for the $2.3 billion offering to 89% by 12:30 p.m. IST, exchange data showed.
Up to half of the NSE's IPO is reserved for qualified institutional buyers (QIBs), including anchor investors, while about 35% of the shares are set aside for retail investors.
